instruction: Create a Windows image with IIS installed
output: echo 'source "amazon-ebs" "windows" { communicator = "winrm" winrm_username = "Administrator" } build { sources = ["source.amazon-ebs.windows"] provisioner "powershell" { inline = ["Install-WindowsFeature -Name Web-Server"] } }' > windows-iis.pkr.hcl
